annotations.title: Roll back a Cloudflare Pages project

description: Roll a Cloudflare Pages project's production back, or forward, to a production deployment that built successfully; the tool always asks first. The arguments come from cloudflare_pages_read deployments: `replaces` is the id of the deployment marked live (the one serving production now), `deployment` the id of the one to serve, older or newer. A preview, a skipped deployment and a failed build are refused, and so is the deployment serving now; `stale` means another deployment or rollback came first, so read the deployments again before trying again. No new deployment is made: the project serves the chosen one at once, and rolling back to the one it replaced undoes it. The result holds the deployment it replaced and the one serving now. Building and deploying stay with Git and Wrangler.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

deployment.description: The id (a UUID) of the production deployment to serve, as cloudflare_pages_read deployments shows it; older or newer than the one serving now.

project.description: The Pages project's name, as `list` shows it: 1–58 lowercase letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

replaces.description: The id (a UUID) of the production deployment serving now: the one cloudflare_pages_read deployments marks live. The call is refused as stale when another deployment or rollback came first.

name: cloudflare_pages_rollback

live.description: Whether this is the production deployment serving now; a rollback takes its id as replaces.
